verdict.rationale: Fellow documents that every meeting automatically produces suggested AI action items. Action items carry assignees and due dates, and they are collected in a queryable list that can be filtered by assignee and marked complete or archived. However, the evidence does not explicitly say that owners are assigned automatically during AI extraction, and the items are described as 'suggested' rather than auto-committed. missing for 10: explicit evidence that AI extraction assigns owners automatically, documentation of an in-app action-item tracking view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, action items with owners are automatically extracted from the conversation and collected somewhere I can track them

citations.quote: You automatically receive a clear meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting.
action items with assignees and due dates
assigned_to_me: Only action items assigned to the authenticated user
